'''Marvin''' is a male student NPC found outside of the Infirmary, who is part of the Debate Fan Club.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Marvin:''' Hey there, interested in debating? You're welcome to join our Debate Fan Club!
:{{DIcon}} (Listen to the debate topics.)
:'''Marvin:''' Let's see… the hottest topic right now is—
:'''Marvin:''' "Does falling in love with a virtual character count as real love?"
:'''Marvin:''' Ahem… Gotta keep up with the times! But don't worry, we've got classics too!
:'''Marvin:''' "Does preserving civilization sometimes hold back its progress?"
:'''Marvin:''' "If Solaris is a simulated world, does it still have meaning?"
:'''Marvin:''' Most topics aren't about right or wrong. Debating is really about thinking and learning to speak your mind.
:'''Marvin:''' Plus, it's great practice for building up the nerve to face your thesis committee!
:{{DIcon}} "I choose to improve my thesis quality.
:{{DIcon}} This actually sounds helpful.
:'''Marvin:''' Then feel free to join anytime!
{{Dialogue End}}
